name: Lucid
description: Simplify your workflow by using Claude to generate foundational Lucidchart diagrams directly from your conversation. Beyond seamless diagram creation, this integration acts as a digital bridge, allowing you to instantly search, retrieve, share, and summarize your existing Lucid documents right within Claude. Whether you are jumpstarting a new process map or extracting insights from complex boards, you can now eliminate the bottleneck of context-switching and provide your AI with the visual context it needs to accelerate your work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lucid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lucid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lucid.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lucid MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lucid provides these MCP tools: search, fetch, lucid_create_document_share_link, share_document_with_collaborators, lucid_create_org_chart, lucid_create_diagram_from_specification, lucid_create_mind_map, lucid_create_sequence_diagram, _lucid_create_embed, _lucid_create_embed_session_token, and lucid_export_document_as_PNG.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lucid?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lucid in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Lucid requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lucid is developed by Lucid Software. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
